960	### Bound delegated adapter execution
961	
962	Declare an optional `containment` object on each agent in `.pose/policy/delegation.json`. Use containment schema 1 and `trusted-process`. This backend runs a trusted local executable; a disposable worktree shares Git metadata and does not isolate filesystem, original repository, network, credential files, CPU or memory. Required guarantees that the host cannot enforce are refused before reserving an attempt or spawning a process. Linux process-group termination requires an observable process inventory and is checked after kill; descendants that escape the group remain outside its coverage. Windows/other ports do not qualify group containment from a cross-build.
